column1: # claude-html's price list: what a token cost at Anthropic's API list price, in USD per million tokens.
# One line per model and per price period. A reply is priced by the line whose from..to holds its day
# (UTC, both days included); an empty "to" is today's price. When a price changes, set "to" on the old
# line to the day before and add a line from the day of the change. A new model is a new line.
# model: the id Claude Code records (message.model). A dated id (claude-haiku-4-5-20251001) is priced by
#   the line without the date. "/fast" is a reply in fast mode (usage.speed), "/over-100k" a Haiku 5.5
#   prompt over 100,000 tokens: both have prices of their own. An id with no line is "not priced".
# cache_write_5m / cache_write_1h: 5-minute and 1-hour cache writes. cache_read: cache hits and refreshes.
# source: the official page(s) the figures and the dates come from. checked: when they were last compared.
# Standard rates only: no batch discount, no US-only (inference_geo) 1.1x, no cloud-platform prices.
# A "from" is the model's launch day in the release notes when no price change was recorded since;
# a line starting on its "checked" day is one whose earlier start could not be confirmed.
